content: OpenTelemetry logging guidance recommends correlation across logs and traces using execution context (trace/span IDs), resource context, timestamps, severity, event name, and attributes; the log data model includes exception information and event names. This project has no telemetry dependency and should not add one merely for this milestone, but the same principle supports a lightweight local correlation record: round id, host/request id, process id, component, event, monotonic elapsed time, deadline, cancellation/disconnect reason, HTTP status, and exit signal, with question/answer content excluded or redacted.
